flows.title: Plugin discovery and lifecycle
flows.summary: Emby discovers plugin/providers/services; PluginEntryPoint connects runtime services, hooks, caches, workers and timers. Reflection targets remain runtime capabilities, not build guarantees.

flows.title: Settings and refresh
flows.summary: The AMD view serializes autosaves to the custom Admin endpoint; Plugin normalizes/persists settings and refreshes only content-affecting changes using shared configuration hashing.

flows.title: Channel tree and media construction
flows.summary: The partial channel routes folder IDs, pages and enriches videos, classifies Shorts/live entries and persists stable watch-page identities. Direct mode replaces playback sources through a dynamic callback. Trending and live folders have distinct aggregate/probe paths.

flows.title: Native media, bounded quality, compatible audio/video and captions
flows.summary: Enabled direct mode resolves VOD media inside Emby through a pinned source-compiled managed adapter, bounded HTTP, shared flights and request backoff. The resolver extracts no executable and uses no subprocess or program updater. Harmony retains its approved temporary native helper exception; ordinary Emby cache/settings remain outside the DLL. Sources/output retain1080p compatibility bounds; client and global Emby bitrate limits are not overridden. A separately measured CDN budget selects startup HLS/HTTPS quality, not continuous ABR. A denied/invalid HLS master is not bypassed. Native Emby transcoding owns resume; late corrective seeks and watch-player fallback are disabled. Deterministic audio identities expose actual supported original/dub tracks and map only the selected audio input with the video timeline. Encoded output retains30fps compatibility safeguards. Each new native playback defaults subtitles Off even for client-supplied automatic/remembered positive indices; CurrentPlaySessionId preserves manual choices during playback; selected owned VTT tracks use scoped native rendering rather than depending on the client's external renderer. Real resolver chapters or a strict description chapter block project onto native item DTOs without synchronous network access, preserving user edits/deletions and intro/credit markers. Exact runtime signatures, operating systems and physical client rendering require separate verification. Running HLS URLs are not automatically renewed on expiry.

flows.title: Native YouTube audio/video compatibility
flows.summary: Exact native hooks prefer client-advertised H264 and, for known mono/stereo or unknown layout, existing AAC on independently validated plugin-owned sources. Preferences use local cloned arrays. An output-only channel cap prevents native unknown-layout six-channel fallback while preserving lower bounds, known multichannel, copy eligibility and truthful source metadata. Missing runtime signatures fail visibly; lazy interface assembly resolution is handled at signature binding. Actual encoded frames, audio channels, timeline and unaffected ordinary media require tests separate from source-map freshness.

flows.title: Pinned managed player-response source subset
flows.summary: A modified MIT source subset is compiled into the plugin. VideoController uses one fixed player identity; the bounded outer transport validates each request and stops on denial. PlayerResponse supplies original format/caption fields; internal BCL helpers replace excluded external packages. No downloaded player JavaScript, client-identity fallback, subprocess, runtime updater or host-termination package is included. Upstream hashes and explicit modifications are recorded separately from local adapter code.

flows.title: Requests, cache and quota accounting
flows.summary: Endpoint wrappers use memory/disk caches and coalesced misses, then throttled/retried HTTP. Quota accounting occurs on dispatched attempts. Global-memory and targeted-playlist invalidation have different disk behavior.

flows.title: Playlist change detection
flows.summary: The poller fetches uncached playlist snapshots, persists compact fingerprints and requests a serialized deep refresh for a changed established snapshot; failed fetches are not valid empty snapshots.

flows.title: Playback intent, session state and resume
flows.summary: Legacy playback interception captures explicit start intent and session events maintain guarded resume state/checkpoints. Commands require exact playback identity and transport. Direct mode bypasses these corrections and uses native resume with video streamcopy disabled.

flows.title: Dashboard player and caption boundaries
flows.summary: Outside direct mode dashboard interception rewrites selected external Emby bundles and serves the embedded iframe player. Legacy native caption-off commands do not guarantee visible client behavior; the historical caption metadata source is excluded from compilation. Direct mode serves original resources and native separate subtitle tracks instead.

flows.title: Managed Home sections
flows.summary: The Home manager derives per-user rows from visible saved channel roots, uses plugin-owned IDs and runtime-discovered mutation APIs, and persists reversible aggregate/filter migration state.

flows.title: Artwork, ordering and diagnostics
flows.summary: Providers and item-update hooks restore plugin-owned artwork; queued sort/image writes respect shared scan activity. Shared logging tees to a bounded plugin-owned file.
